name: 赫斯珀·灯崖
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:1649
who: Hesper, a demon-kin night-wing of the Lamp-Cliff family who runs orders along the top of the long wall for the guild, forty-two but looking just over twenty: about 179 cm, tall and thin, broad-shouldered and light-boned, landing without a sound. A pair of brown feathered wings at his back with soft, downy edges like an owl's, silent when they beat, a ring of white spots at the wingtips; in the middle of the left wing a hole the size of a coin, burned through by a lamp when he was small, so lamplight shines through it. Messy dark red hair the colour of a burnt wick, honey-coloured eyes that need only a glint of light to see. A chattering, quick-tongued, warm-hearted air.
build: 179 cm, tall and thin: broad shoulders, a narrow waist and light bones.
palette: owl brown and white, burnt-wick red, honey gold, old lamp brass, one strip of blue cloth
casual: His runner's gear: a close-fitting short leather jerkin with the cuffs and trouser legs bound close, two slits cut in the back for the wings, a strip of blue cloth tied round the left upper arm with a small cast war badge of shield, broken sword and banner pinned beside it, the guild's bronze rank emblem of a wind feather and an arrow on a cord, dark trousers and soft boots; at his belt an old brass lamp whose shade is stamped with the worn mark of the old lamp road; the corner of a sealed letter showing at the neck of his jerkin. He holds the lit lamp up at shoulder height, a quick, talkative grin.
private: Off watch in the bell tower at night: the jerkin off, a washed-out linen shirt with two slits for the wings and a patch of a different colour at the elbow, the sleeves rolled up, dark trousers, bare feet, the wings half open and slack. He holds the unfinished letter in one hand and a stub of pencil in the other. A rare quiet, homesick look.
battle: Running orders along the wall top in the dark: the leather jerkin buckled tight, the blue cloth on the left arm, leather bracers, the wings half spread. He holds the old brass lamp up at shoulder height in his left hand and a short knife low in his right. A fierce, alert look. In this outfit the strip of blue cloth is tied round his LEFT upper arm (on the viewer's right when he faces us), the arm that holds the lamp up; his right arm, the knife arm, has no cloth on it.
formal: At the Ceasefire Day reading of names in the gate tunnel: a clean dark brown wool short coat with two slits for the wings, buttoned to the collar, the blue cloth and the war badge pinned neatly on the left arm, the wind-feather emblem on its cord, the unlit lamp at his belt, the hair combed down for once. He stands very straight with the wings folded neat, a serious, slightly awkward look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the honey-coloured eyes laughing at the viewer, the old brass lamp held near his cheek, its warm light shining through the coin-sized hole in the brown wing behind him. Warm lamplight from one side, cold night blue on the other, the dark top of a white stone wall behind. Foreground blur: soft owl-brown feathers, the brass lamp shade and the corner of a folded letter. He wears the short leather jerkin with the blue cloth on his left arm.

name: 森克·霍恩
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:1705
who: Senk Horn, a human bugler of the east slope garrison on the long wall, from a family that has blown the calls on the wall for generations, twenty-two: about 174 cm, thin and narrow-shouldered, with a deep chest and breath enough for the longest call on the wall. Short flaxen hair, light blue eyes, a young face that is always set tight; a ring of hard callus round his lips from the mouthpiece. At his hip his late father's brass bugle, a dent in its bell rubbed bright, which makes every call he blows half a tone low. A stubborn, rule-keeping air: he is afraid and holds his ground anyway.
build: 174 cm, thin: narrow shoulders and a deep chest.
palette: garrison slate blue and steel grey, worn brass, flaxen gold, a little faded white
casual: His bugler's armour of the east slope garrison: a short slate-blue wool coat over a leather brigandine of small riveted plates, a leather gorget, a copper bugler's badge pinned on the chest, grey trousers and boots; the dented brass bugle hanging at his hip on a cord, the dent polished bright; a short sword at the back of his belt that he has never drawn. He stands very straight as if his back were against a wall, one hand on the bugle, a tense, serious look.
private: At home under the gate tower of a wall town: a washed-out linen shirt with a patch of a different colour at the elbow, a grey knitted vest, grey trousers and soft shoes. He holds a soft cloth and the dented bugle, rubbing the dent. A quiet, guarded look.
battle: On the bell tower in the night tide: the brigandine buckled tight, a plain steel cap, leather bracers, the slate-blue coat belted. He holds the dented bugle up near his mouth in both hands, ready to sound, the short sword sheathed at his back. A frightened but unmoving look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and unmoving, the back straight as if pressed against a stone wall, the feet planted, a tense, frightened but steady expression, holding the dented brass bugle up near his mouth in both hands; the short sword stays sheathed.
formal: At the Ceasefire Day bell-ringing at the broken gate: the slate-blue garrison coat brushed clean and buttoned to the collar, the copper bugler's badge polished and a small cast war badge pinned beside it, the dented bugle on a new cord. He stands very straight with the bugle held against his chest, a solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the light blue eyes looking at the viewer, tense, his lips just at the mouthpiece of the dented brass bugle raised near his face. Cold blue night light from one side and the faint red glow of a horn-bugle's fire from the other, as if from beyond the wall. Foreground blur: the brass bell of the bugle with its shining dent, drifting stone dust and a white stone parapet. He wears the slate-blue bugler's coat with the copper badge.
art_extra: His short flaxen hair is a pale warm straw blond exactly as in the sprite, NOT silver or white.

name: 莎菲雅·熔环
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:1761
who: Saffia of the Molten-Ring clan, a fire-horn demon-kin bugler of the Azure Flame Horn City legion on the west slope of the long wall, forty-three but looking just over twenty: tall, about 182 cm, broad-shouldered and long-legged. A pair of horns curling back half a turn, their surface ringed with fine lines like the rings of a tree. Pale reddish-copper skin with a faint flush of red at the sides of the neck. Black hair with a dark red sheen, cut at the jaw; honey-orange eyes; three small copper rings in a row on the left ear. At her hip her grandmother's horn-bugle, made from her grandmother's own horn, its mouth bound with mountain copper and a small ember glowing inside. A plain-spoken, warm, stubborn air. Her hair is black, almost blue-black, with only a faint dark red sheen on the highlights; it must not read as red, auburn or maroon. The horns grow from above the temples and sweep straight back along the sides of the head, curling down half a turn behind it like a ram's; they do not stand up or point upward.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young woman's face of about twenty, frank and strong-boned: medium, gently slanted almond eyes of honey orange with a level gaze; straight dark brows; a firm mouth. Pale reddish-copper skin with very little shading and a faint red flush at the sides of the neck, skin shadows a soft warm red-brown.
build: 182 cm, tall: broad shoulders and a deep chest, a full bust, a firm narrow waist and full hips, long legs.
palette: obsidian black and flame red, reddish copper, honey orange, a little mountain copper
casual: Her bugler's armour of the Azure Flame Horn City legion: a black leather jerkin with black obsidian-steel pauldrons branded with a ring of fire pattern, over a dark red wool tunic, dark trousers and heavy boots; no armband, she is of the west slope; at her hip her grandmother's horn-bugle on a strap, its mouth bound in mountain copper, a dot of ember glowing inside; a short-hilted curved blade on her back. She stands with one palm resting on the horn as if warming it, a frank, steady look.
private: Off watch in the legion's camp behind the line: a loose charcoal wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up and a patch of a different colour on one elbow, a dark red knitted vest, dark trousers, soft boots, the horn-bugle still at her hip. She holds a small tin cup of warm honeyed milk. A tired, softer look.
battle: On the west side of the bell tower: the black leather jerkin buckled tight under the fire-branded obsidian-steel pauldrons, leather bracers, a dark red sash. She holds her grandmother's horn-bugle in her left hand, a small flame flickering at its copper-bound mouth, and grips the short curved blade low in her right. A fierce, direct look.
formal: On Ceasefire Day, walking in through the west mouth of the broken gate: the legion's black dress coat with a high collar buttoned to the throat, a band of fire pattern stitched in dark red at the cuffs, the branded pauldrons polished, the horn-bugle on a new strap. She stands very upright with one hand on the horn, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the honey-orange eyes looking at the viewer frankly, the horn-bugle raised near her lips, a small flame at its copper mouth throwing red light across half her face, cold night blue on the other side. Foreground blur: drifting sparks, the ringed curve of a horn and a white stone parapet. She wears the black leather jerkin with the fire-branded pauldrons.

name: 伊索尔德·罗斯雯
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:1908
who: Isolde Rosewen, a human knight of the Rose kingdom from a fencing house of the rose city, at twenty-six, the months before she became a legend: about 170 cm, tall, slender and evenly proportioned, light even in armour, like a sharp thorn hidden in a flowering branch. Rose-gold hair falling over one shoulder, loosely tied with a satin ribbon that the wall wind keeps undoing, no other ornament in it. Light blue eyes, gentle and focused; she looks at people's hands first. Pinned at her chest a sprig of wild grass picked by the road of the evacuation trains, worn on any day someone has died on the line. A courteous, quiet, proud air.
build: 170 cm, tall and slender: a medium bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips, long legs.
palette: pale silver and rose gold, wild-grass green, faded bandage white, a little rose red
casual: Her wall gear as a Rose knight: light armour of pale enchanted silver that guards only what must be guarded, a silver-white breastplate and one pauldron over a fitted rose-grey quilted tunic, a short rose-red half-cape on one shoulder, slim grey trousers and tall boots; at her hip a slim sword whose scabbard is wound with dried wild flowers and old battlefield bandages, a tassel embroidered with a rose hanging under the hilt; a folded list of names tucked inside the breastplate, its edge showing; the sprig of wild grass pinned at her chest. One hand rests on the sword hilt, a gentle, attentive look.
private: At home on the slope of the rose city: a simple long-sleeved cream linen blouse with a modest high collar, a long dusky rose wool skirt, flat shoes, the hair down and tied with the ribbon. She holds the folded list of names and a pen whose shaft is carved with a worn rose. A quiet, sorrowful, steady look.
battle: Holding her stretch of the wall: the pale silver light armour buckled close, leather bracers, a strip of bandage tied round her left forearm, the rose-red half-cape. She holds the slim sword low in a ready guard, the rose tassel swinging under the hilt. A calm, exact look.
formal: Summoned to the king's hall on the night of the reading of names: the dress uniform of a Rose knight, a fitted long coat of white and pale gold with a high collar and fine rose embroidery at the cuffs, a rose-red sash, white gloves, the slim sword with the dried flowers and bandages still on its scabbard; no rose at her chest, only the sprig of roadside grass. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a grave, gentle look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the light blue eyes looking at the viewer gently, a sprig of wild grass at her collar and the rose tassel of the sword near her cheek. Warm golden light from a great rose-shaped chandelier on one side. Foreground blur: a storm of rose petals and the dried flowers wound on the scabbard. She wears the pale silver light armour with the rose-red half-cape.

name: 西尔玛·荆坡
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:1964
who: Selma of Thorn-Slope village, a human flower grower's daughter from the flower valley and the veteran who teaches the sword dance on the Rose kingdom's stretch of the long wall, thirty-eight: about 176 cm, tall, broad-shouldered and strong. Flaxen hair in one thick braid coiled on top of her head so it never comes loose at work. Light blue eyes, cheeks reddened by the wall wind; fine white scars criss-cross the backs of both hands from a childhood of cutting thorny wild roses. A small cloth bag of wild rose seeds hangs at her neck. A loud, foul-mouthed, soft-hearted air: she scolds first, then kneels to tie your bootlace.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman's face of about thirty-eight, open and strong: medium, gently slanted almond eyes of light blue with faint lines at the corners; strong straight brows; a wide mouth made for shouting and laughing; cheeks reddened by the wind. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 176 cm, tall and strong: broad shoulders, a full bust, a sturdy waist and full hips, long legs.
palette: worn leather brown, flaxen gold, wild-rose pink, wall grey, a little red thread
casual: Her wall gear: an old leather cuirass worn soft, its shoulder guards mended again and again with red thread, over a coarse oatmeal wool tunic, brown trousers and boots; at her hip a plain longsword with no ornament, its grip wrapped in cloth that has been replaced many times; the small cloth bag of wild rose seeds on a cord at her neck. Fists on her hips, a loud, warm, scolding grin.
private: On the threshing floor at home in Thorn-Slope village: a faded blue linen dress with the sleeves rolled up, a coarse apron with a patch of a different colour, the braid still coiled on her head, bare feet. She holds a pair of flower shears and a bunch of small thorny wild roses. A relaxed, laughing look.
battle: On the wall when the tide comes: the old leather cuirass buckled tight, leather bracers, the seed bag tucked inside the collar. She holds the plain longsword in both hands, low and forward, her feet set as if for the dance. A fierce look, her lips counting the beat.
formal: Among the village families in the king's hall on the night of the reading of names: her one good dress, a long dark green wool dress with long sleeves and a high collar, a cream shawl, the braid coiled and pinned with a sprig of wild rose, the seed bag at her neck. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the light blue eyes laughing and fierce, one scarred hand raised mid-clap as if beating time, the coiled flaxen braid catching the light. Warm firelight of a threshing-floor bonfire from one side. Foreground blur: drifting wild rose petals, flying chaff and a pair of flower shears. She wears the old leather cuirass mended with red thread.

name: 昂利·费尔伯
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:2020
who: Henri Felber, a human sword-for-hire who takes other people's places in the duelling ring of the rose city, thirty-six: about 181 cm, lean and long-armed, narrow-shouldered, his weight always on the back foot so he can step away. Black hair with a blue sheen, cropped very short, as the children of the dyers' riverbank wear it so it never takes the dye. Pale violet eyes that look at the wrist of a sword hand before the face. Half of the little finger of his left hand is missing. A small bottle of perfume in his pocket, to cover the smell of blood. A dry, terse, guarded air: he names his price before anything else.
build: 181 cm, lean and long-armed: narrow shoulders and a tight waist.
palette: dyer's indigo and slate, pale violet, washed-out grey linen, a little steel
casual: His duelling-day clothes: a good fitted indigo coat rented for the day, cut close with a short skirt and a row of dull buttons, over a grey linen shirt washed thin, slim dark trousers and soft boots; at his hip a slim sword whose grip is worn shiny; a small glass bottle of perfume in the coat pocket. He stands loosely with his weight on the back foot, the right hand resting on the sword hilt, a dry, appraising look.
private: At home in his one room on the dyers' riverbank: a washed-out grey linen shirt with a patch of a different colour at the elbow, dark trousers, worn slippers, the rented coat folded away. He holds a small wooden practice sword, a boy's, by its grip. A quiet, closed look.
battle: Ready in the ring: the rented coat taken off and folded away, a fitted padded grey doublet with leather at the shoulders, leather gloves, slim trousers and soft boots. He holds the slim sword low and forward, its point angled at an opponent's wrist, his weight on the back foot. A cool, dry look.
formal: Going up to the wall with the winter shift, his own name on the roll for the first time: his own plain dark indigo wool coat, not rented, buttoned to the collar over a clean pale grey shirt, a sprig of roadside grass pinned at the chest, the slim sword at his hip, no perfume at the collar. He stands very upright with the hands at his sides, a quiet, steady look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale violet eyes looking at the viewer's hand rather than the face, a dry half-smile, his maimed left hand lifting the small perfume bottle near his collar. Cold blue light off a riverbank of indigo dye vats from one side. Foreground blur: long lengths of indigo cloth hung to dry, a falling rose petal and a small wooden sword. He wears the rented indigo coat.

name: 卢米安·塞尔梅尔
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:2163
who: Lumian Selmer, a human seer of the tower on the west shore of the Silver Lake that reads the lake's reflections, thirty years old, three years before he became a legend, and like a hero aging slowly he looks twenty-seven or twenty-eight: about 183 cm, tall, slender and long-limbed, moving as if afraid to bump into something. Long lake-blue hair, darker at the roots and brighter blue at the ends, falling down his back and loosely tied with a strip of cloth soaked in lake water; a fine mist always clings to his hair and robe; no ornament on his brow. Deep green eyes, still as the bottom of a lake. A ring of rippling water often circles the fingertips of his right hand. A gentle, uncertain, careful air; he never chooses for anyone. His reader's robe is a Western long coat-robe closed down the front with plain buttons, with a plain stand collar and fitted sleeves: NOT a crossed wrap collar, NOT wide hanging sleeves, no knotted cord fastenings. The copper basin is wide and shallow like a dish, about the width of his forearm, never a deep pot or cauldron.
build: 183 cm, slender: a thin chest and back, long arms and legs.
palette: lake teal and mist grey, deep green, old copper, a little water silver
casual: The robe of the tower's reflection-readers: a long lake-teal robe with thin copper plates sewn inside it, a row of small squares embroidered along the sleeve cuff, one filled in for each night of watching, dark trousers and soft boots;, its bottom polished bright; a small notebook tucked in his breast. He holds the basin in both hands at chest height, a still film of water in it, a quiet, faraway look. There is only ONE copper basin, the one he holds in both hands at chest height; nothing hangs at his waist in this outfit.
private: At the lake edge below the tower: a loose pale grey linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up and a patch of a different colour on one sleeve, dark trousers, bare feet, the damp hair hanging loose. He holds a piece of dried fish in one hand. A gentle, absent smile.
battle: On the broken causeway in the flood tide: the lake-teal robe belted tight and hitched up, the copper basin at his hip, leather bracers. He carries no weapon: both hands raised palm-out, he lifts the water at his feet into a standing, rippling wall. A frightened but steady look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and unsteady, the feet planted wide, a pale, determined expression, both hands raised palm-out at chest height with a thin sheet of water rising between them; he carries no weapon.
formal: Before the long table of the Star Mirror Council: the reader's robe brushed and dried for once, a pale silver-grey stole with small copper beads at its ends, the copper basin on a polished chain at his waist, the hair tied neatly. He stands very straight with the hands folded over the notebook, a grave, uncertain look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the deep green eyes lifting from the copper basin he holds near his face to the viewer, a damp lock of lake-blue hair across the frame. Cool rippling light reflected from water below on one side. Foreground blur: drifting water droplets and broken fragments of a reflected city of towers. He wears the long lake-teal robe.

name: 妮侬·苇染
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:2219
who: Ninon of the Reed-Dye family, a human herb-gatherer of the thousand pools of the misty marsh below the Silver Lake, whose family ties red cloth on the reeds to mark the paths, twenty-six: short, about 160 cm, sturdy, her legs strong from wading. Fluffy ginger curls cut short and ragged, tied back from her eyes with a strip of red cloth; apricot-yellow eyes that look first at what is under your feet; a sprinkle of light freckles across the nose and cheeks, reddened by the marsh wind. A faded ring of red cloth wound round her left wrist. She always goes barefoot in the pools. A quick, sharp-tongued, soft-hearted air. The faded ring of red cloth is always on her LEFT wrist (on the viewer's right when she faces us).
build: 160 cm, short and sturdy: a medium bust, a firm waist and gently rounded hips, strong legs.
palette: madder red and marsh green, ginger orange, oilcloth olive, mud brown
casual: Her marsh gear: a short oilcloth jacket with the sleeves pushed to the elbow and the hem tucked into her belt, over a coarse linen shirt and knee-length breeches; at her belt a curved reed-cutting knife, a roll of red cloth and a leather basket of herbs; bare feet, a thin cord tied round one ankle hung with a few dried reed seeds that rustle when she wades. She holds up a strip of red cloth in one hand, a sharp, challenging look.
private: In the reed-thatched house on the red-cloth pool: a faded madder-red linen dress with a patched apron, bare feet, the curls loose. She holds a bundle of bitter reed roots and a small knife. A rare quiet, warm look.
battle: Leading people out through the flooded pools: the oilcloth jacket buttoned up, the roll of red cloth slung across her shoulder, a lantern at her belt, bare feet in the mud. She grips the curved reed-cutting knife low in one hand and holds a strip of red cloth taut in the other. A fierce, focused look.
formal: Her wedding day on the broken causeway: a simple long cream linen dress with a red sash, a wreath of reeds and small red flowers in the ginger curls, the faded red cloth still on her wrist, bare feet. She holds a single reed stalk, the marsh sign of a promise accepted. A bright, stubborn, happy look. The wedding dress is a plain Western peasant dress with a round neckline and fitted sleeves to the elbow, NOT a crossed wrap collar or wide hanging sleeves; the red sash is a narrow ribbon tied in a small bow at the side, with no long panel hanging down the front.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the apricot-yellow eyes looking at the viewer with a cocky challenge, a strip of red cloth held between her fingers near her cheek, the freckles bright. Pale grey-gold marsh light through mist from one side. Foreground blur: reeds, a tied strip of red cloth fluttering and drifting mist. She wears the short oilcloth jacket with the sleeves pushed up.

name: 克洛蒂尔德·杜朗
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:2275
who: Clotilde Durand, a human from a fishing family of the south shore of the Silver Lake and the old reflection-reader of the Tide Tower, seventy-five: small, about 151 cm, a little hunched, yet quick on the tower's three hundred steps. Very short white hair, stiff as a brush; water-cyan eyes she narrows at people as if watching a far-off tide; a deeply lined, weathered face. The top joint of her left little finger is missing, lost to a boat rope when she was young, and she taps people's foreheads with the stump. Dried fish and bread always in her pockets, half for herself and half for her apprentices. A sharp, brisk, unsentimental air with a warm heart under it. Her clothes are Western: every robe closes down the front with buttons and has a plain stand or turned-down collar, NOT a crossed wrap collar, with fitted sleeves, NOT wide hanging sleeves; her shawl is fastened with a plain round copper pin, with NO knotted-cord ornament and NO tassel anywhere. Her white hair is cropped very short, about a finger's length, and stands up stiff like a brush; it is not a soft wavy bob.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old woman's face of about seventy-five, NOT young: narrowed water-cyan almond eyes with deep crow's feet, lines across the brow and beside the mouth, thin white brows, a small sharp nose, a thin mouth set firm, the cheeks a little sunken. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 151 cm, small, thin and wiry with a slight stoop.
palette: lake teal washed pale, white, old copper, lantern amber
casual: The reader's robe she has worn for decades: a long lake-teal robe washed almost white, the row of small squares along the cuff long since filled and continued up inside the sleeve, a dark knitted shawl, soft boots; at her waist a shallow copper basin and a small wooden mallet whose handle her grip has turned black; a knot of dried fish and bread poking from a pocket. She holds a ship's lantern in one hand and squints at you, a brisk, scolding look.
private: At home in her room at the foot of the Tide Tower: a plain grey wool dress with long sleeves, a patched apron, thick knitted stockings and soft shoes. She holds out a piece of dried fish to someone. A gruff, kind look.
battle: On the tide-watching platform the night the well spills over: the faded robe belted tight, the shawl knotted across her chest, a rope round her waist tying her to the bell post. She grips the small wooden mallet in both hands, ready to strike the bell. A fierce, unmoving look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and unmoving, the feet planted, a fierce expression, gripping a small wooden bell mallet in both hands as if about to strike a bell; she carries no weapon.
formal: Signing at the long table of the Star Mirror Council: her one good robe, deep lake-teal with a narrow silver edge, a clean white collar, the copper basin polished at her waist, the white hair brushed flat. She stands as straight as her back allows, the hands folded over the mallet, a stern look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the water-cyan eyes narrowed at the viewer as if reading a tide, the stump of her left little finger raised as if to tap a forehead. Cold grey-blue mist light from one side and the warm glow of a ship's lantern on the other. Foreground blur: the rim of a cracked bronze bell, drifting mist and a piece of dried fish. She wears the faded lake-teal robe. She holds her LEFT hand (on the viewer's right when she faces us) out toward the viewer with the stump of the little finger, short by one joint, extended as if to tap the viewer's forehead; she does not touch her own head.

name: 苍风·岚野
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:2418
who: Azure Wind of the Mistfield family, a human rider who races airships and wyverns on the high plateau routes and flies the boats that carry the wounded off the front, thirty years old, in the weeks before he became a legend, and looking about twenty-six: about 176 cm, wiry, light-boned and quick, standing as if about to step off into the air. Blue-grey hair tied at the nape, a few wind-tossed locks at the brow, nothing worn on his head. Pale grey eyes with a faint cyan tint, cold as the wind in a mountain pass when he is serious and boyish when he laughs. Wind-reddened cheeks, lips chapped by the cold. A carefree, gambling, kind-hearted air; he cannot walk away from a cry for help. He wears NO goggles anywhere, not on the head, not round the neck, not at the belt; the goggles in the reference picture belong to a later time.
build: 176 cm, wiry and light-boned: a lean waist, narrow hips and strong hands.
palette: storm blue-grey and brown leather, cream sheepskin, eagle-feather brown, a little frost white
casual: His racer's clothes: a short brown leather jacket with a turned-down sheepskin collar, the cuffs tied tight with leather thongs, a few eagle feathers sewn onto the jacket, a worn cream scarf long enough to wind three times round his neck, dark trousers tucked into laced boots; at his hip his family's straight single-edged long blade in a plain western hilt, the scabbard carved with a small bell; a pouch of frozen meat strips for his wyvern. He holds a coin between two fingers as if betting on the wind, a cocky, easy grin.
